title: Ice cream cone, soft serve, chocolate, waffle cone

content.title: About
content.content: Soft‑serve chocolate ice cream served in a crisp waffle cone. The combination of creamy texture and rich chocolate flavor makes it a popular treat in cafés and on the street.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Chocolate soft‑serve is commonly served in waffle cones in the US and Europe.
The waffle cone adds a crunchy texture and a subtle toasted flavor.
Traditional recipes use milk, cream, sugar and cocoa mass.
Soft‑serve is frozen at a higher temperature than regular ice cream, giving it a lighter, airy consistency.
Waffle cones can be tinted and decorated with sprinkles.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: Dairy ingredients provide calcium, essential for bones and teeth.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Cocoa mass is rich in flavonoids that may support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Provides quick energy from sugars and fats.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Milk and cream contain vitamins B2 and B12, important for metabolism.

items.title: Mood enhancement
items.content: Sweet chocolate flavor can stimulate serotonin production, improving mood.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Excessive consumption may contribute to weight gain and elevated blood glucose.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Dairy components can cause discomfort for people who are lactose intolerant.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to casein.

items.title: Potential nut or soy additives
items.content: Some recipes may include nut‑based or soy‑based emulsifiers.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: The waffle cone adds extra calories and carbohydrates.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve immediately after preparation while the ice cream is still soft. Top with sprinkles, nuts, fruit sauce, or caramel for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen at –18 °C or lower. The waffle cone is best used right away, as it can become soggy over time.
